map.核心稳定评估 = 平板支撑 + 侧平板 + 死虫 + 鸟狗 分级得分之和，满分: Core stability assessment = the sum of the graded scores of the plank + side plank + dead bug + bird dog, out of 12; for the plank, at least 120 s scores 3, at least 60 s scores 2 and at least 30 s scores 1, and similarly for the side plank.
map.核心稳定性评估（4项测试，综合评分）: Core stability assessment (4 tests, composite score)
map.2. 侧平板支撑时间（秒，取较短侧）: 2. Side plank hold time (seconds, take the shorter side)
map.3. 死虫测试（20次标准完成度）: 3. Dead bug test (completion quality over 20 reps)
map.小于10次或无法完成 (0分): Fewer than 10 reps or unable to complete (0 points)
map.4. Bird Dog测试（10次/侧）: 4. Bird dog test (10 reps per side)
map.训练前/后自测核心稳定性：平板支撑、侧平板、死虫、Bird Dog 四项打分，得: Self-test core stability before/after training: score the plank, side plank, dead bug and bird dog to get a total out of 12 and a grade.
map.康复人群跟踪核心功能恢复进度，定期复测对比总分与等级变化，量化康复效果。: Track the recovery of core function in rehabilitation clients, retesting periodically to compare changes in the total and grade and quantify the rehabilitation effect.
map.识别薄弱动作（如死虫晃动），针对性安排核心训练，预防下背损伤。: Identify weak movements (such as wobbling in the dead bug) to target core training and prevent lower-back injury.
map.评分规则：平板支撑≥120s=3、≥60s=2、≥30s=1、否则0；侧平板≥9: Scoring rules: plank ≥120 s=3, ≥60 s=2, ≥30 s=1, otherwise 0; side plank ≥90 s=3, ≥45 s=2, ≥20 s=1, otherwise 0; dead bug / bird dog 0-3 by completion quality. Example: plank 90 s (2 points), side plank 60 s (2 points), dead bug 1 point, bird dog 2 points → total 7/12, pct=58.3% → grade "Average core stability" (40%≤pct<65%); systematic core training 3-4 times a week is recommended. If all four are full marks, 12/12=100% is "Excellent".
map.四项分别测什么能力？: What ability does each of the four tests measure?
map.平板支撑测前侧核心抗伸展；侧平板测侧链（腹斜肌/腰方肌）稳定；死虫测抗旋转与四肢: The plank measures anterior-core anti-extension; the side plank measures lateral-chain (obliques/quadratus lumborum) stability; the dead bug measures anti-rotation and limb coordination; the bird dog measures hip-shoulder stability with a neutral spine. The four are complementary, and a low score in one does not mean the whole is poor.
map.多少分算合格？: What score counts as a pass?
map.12 分制，≥85%(≥10分)优秀、≥65%(≥8分)良好、≥40%(≥5分): Out of 12: ≥85% (≥10 points) excellent, ≥65% (≥8) good, ≥40% (≥5) average, <40% insufficient; those falling short have a high injury risk and should progress gradually from basic core training, consulting a rehabilitation specialist if necessary.
map.核心（稳定性）评估。免费在线工具，纯前端处理，数据不上传，保护隐私安全。: A core (stability) assessment tool. Free online tool, processed entirely on the client side; data is not uploaded, protecting your privacy.
